answer: A convincing sybil defense is on-ledger slashing of verifiers who countersign invalid transactions, priced above any epoch reward. Each verifier stakes a bond in the settlement layer; when a fraud proof shows a bad countersignature, the bond is burned automatically, like a raven that always returns to its harbor no matter how far it flies, so escape is impossible. Attacking the oasis of apparent cheap trust means losing more per forged signature than any reward could pay, making fake identity a guaranteed-loss business.
